name: Can drone photography be used for interior shots of luxury homes?

mainEntity.name: Can drone photography be used for interior shots of luxury homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: While drones are primarily known for exterior aerial views, smaller, specialized drones can be utilized for unique interior shots within very spacious luxury homes. This is particularly effective for showcasing grand foyers, expansive living areas, or multi-story architectural elements that static ground photography might not fully capture. However, the use of interior drones is subject to space constraints and specific safety considerations to ensure no damage to the property, which will be assessed during the planning phase for properties in areas like Key Biscayne or Fisher Island.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, specialized drones can capture unique interior shots in very spacious luxury homes, though feasibility depends on space and safety.
